mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.row_version, s.created_at, s.updated_at, s.chapter_id, s.storyboard_revision_id, s.project_id, s.project_location_id, s.order_index, s.title, s.narration, s.duration_seconds, s.location_text, s.status FROM scenes s JOIN chapters c ON c.id = s.chapter_id WHERE c.id = #{chapterId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.storyboard_revision_id = c.current_storyboard_revision_id ORDER BY s.order_index, s.id

SELECT id, row_version, created_at, updated_at, chapter_id, storyboard_revision_id, project_id, project_location_id, order_index, title, narration, duration_seconds, location_text, status FROM scenes WHERE id = #{id} AND chapter_id = #{chapterId} FOR UPDATE

INSERT INTO scenes (row_version, created_at, updated_at, chapter_id, storyboard_revision_id, project_id, project_location_id, order_index, title, narration, duration_seconds, location_text, status) VALUES (#{rowVersion}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{chapterId}, #{storyboardRevisionId}, #{projectId}, #{projectLocationId}, #{orderIndex}, #{title}, #{narration}, #{durationSeconds}, #{locationText}, #{status}) RETURNING id

SELECT id, row_version, created_at, updated_at, scene_id, order_index, source_start, source_end, source_anchor_json::text AS source_anchor_json, purpose, summary, importance, story_functions_json::text AS story_functions_json, continuity_state_json::text AS continuity_state_json FROM story_beats WHERE scene_id IN #{id} ORDER BY scene_id, order_index, id

INSERT INTO story_beats (row_version, created_at, updated_at, scene_id, order_index, source_start, source_end, source_anchor_json, purpose, summary, importance, story_functions_json, continuity_state_json) VALUES (#{rowVersion}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{sceneId}, #{orderIndex}, #{sourceStart}, #{sourceEnd}, #{sourceAnchorJson}::jsonb, #{purpose}, #{summary}, #{importance}, COALESCE(#{storyFunctionsJson}::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb), COALESCE(#{continuityStateJson}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb)) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE story_beats SET order_index = #{orderIndex}, source_start = #{sourceStart}, source_end = #{sourceEnd}, source_anchor_json = #{sourceAnchorJson}::jsonb, purpose = #{purpose}, summary = #{summary}, importance = #{importance}, story_functions_json = COALESCE(#{storyFunctionsJson}::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb), continuity_state_json = COALESCE(#{continuityStateJson}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), updated_at = #{updatedAt}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND row_version = #{rowVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT id, row_version, created_at, updated_at, story_beat_id, order_index, cue_type, speaker_project_character_id, source_start, source_end, source_anchor_json::text AS source_anchor_json, adaptation_action, adapted_text, delivery_hint, narration_text_start, narration_text_end, audio_start_ms, audio_end_ms, status FROM audio_cues WHERE story_beat_id IN #{id} ORDER BY story_beat_id, order_index, id

INSERT INTO audio_cues (row_version, created_at, updated_at, story_beat_id, order_index, cue_type, speaker_project_character_id, source_start, source_end, source_anchor_json, adaptation_action, adapted_text, delivery_hint, narration_text_start, narration_text_end, audio_start_ms, audio_end_ms, status) VALUES (#{rowVersion}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{storyBeatId}, #{orderIndex}, #{cueType}, #{speakerProjectCharacterId}, #{sourceStart}, #{sourceEnd}, #{sourceAnchorJson}::jsonb, #{adaptationAction}, #{adaptedText}, #{deliveryHint}, #{narrationTextStart}, #{narrationTextEnd}, #{audioStartMs}, #{audioEndMs}, #{status}) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE audio_cues SET order_index = #{orderIndex}, cue_type = #{cueType}, speaker_project_character_id = #{speakerProjectCharacterId}, source_start = #{sourceStart}, source_end = #{sourceEnd}, source_anchor_json = #{sourceAnchorJson}::jsonb, adaptation_action = #{adaptationAction}, adapted_text = #{adaptedText}, delivery_hint = #{deliveryHint}, narration_text_start = #{narrationTextStart}, narration_text_end = #{narrationTextEnd}, audio_start_ms = #{audioStartMs}, audio_end_ms = #{audioEndMs}, status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND row_version = #{rowVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT id, row_version, created_at, updated_at, scene_id, story_beat_id, order_index, title, visual_intent, beat_type, visual_summary, visual_description, visual_direction_json, review_status, motion_mode, relative_weight, visual_focus, aspect_ratio_override, preview_media_asset_id, text_start, text_end, audio_duration_ms, source_anchor_json FROM visual_beats WHERE scene_id IN #{id} ORDER BY scene_id, order_index, id
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(order_index), -1) FROM visual_beats WHERE scene_id = #{sceneId}

INSERT INTO visual_beats (row_version, created_at, updated_at, scene_id, story_beat_id, order_index, title, visual_intent, visual_direction_json, review_status, motion_mode, relative_weight, visual_focus, aspect_ratio_override, preview_media_asset_id, text_start, text_end, audio_duration_ms, source_anchor_json) VALUES (#{rowVersion}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{sceneId}, #{storyBeatId}, #{orderIndex}, #{title}, #{visualIntent}, COALESCE(#{visualDirectionJson}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), #{reviewStatus}, #{motionMode}, COALESCE(CAST(#{relativeWeight} AS numeric), 1.0), COALESCE(#{visualFocus}, 'SPEAKER'), #{aspectRatioOverride}, #{previewMediaAssetId}, #{textStart}, #{textEnd}, #{audioDurationMs}, #{sourceAnchorJson}::jsonb) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE visual_beats SET story_beat_id = #{storyBeatId}, order_index = #{orderIndex}, title = #{title}, visual_intent = #{visualIntent}, visual_direction_json = COALESCE(#{visualDirectionJson}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), review_status = #{reviewStatus}, motion_mode = #{motionMode}, relative_weight = COALESCE(CAST(#{relativeWeight} AS numeric), 1.0), visual_focus = COALESCE(#{visualFocus}, 'SPEAKER'), aspect_ratio_override = #{aspectRatioOverride}, preview_media_asset_id = #{previewMediaAssetId}, text_start = #{textStart}, text_end = #{textEnd}, audio_duration_ms = #{audioDurationMs}, source_anchor_json = #{sourceAnchorJson}::jsonb, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND row_version = #{rowVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT id, row_version, created_at, updated_at, chapter_id, storyboard_revision_id, source_hash, version, adaptation_mode, text, content_hash, status FROM narration_scripts WHERE chapter_id = #{chapterId} ORDER BY version DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, row_version, created_at, updated_at, chapter_id, storyboard_revision_id, source_hash, version, adaptation_mode, text, content_hash, status FROM narration_scripts WHERE chapter_id = #{chapterId} AND storyboard_revision_id = #{storyboardRevisionId} ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO narration_scripts (row_version, created_at, updated_at, chapter_id, storyboard_revision_id, source_hash, version, adaptation_mode, text, content_hash, status) VALUES (#{rowVersion}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{chapterId}, #{storyboardRevisionId}, #{sourceHash}, #{version}, #{adaptationMode}, #{text}, #{contentHash}, #{status}) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE narration_scripts SET text = #{text}, content_hash = #{contentHash}, status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND row_version = #{rowVersion}
